name: Cimmerian-Moulin
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by a subterranean ocean and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
For traders, medicinal compounds and rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
